# Vizogen

> Vizogen is an AI-powered Google Business Profile (GMB) automation platform, owned and operated by NG Marketing Solution, serving local businesses across India — including Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Kolkata, and other cities.

## What Vizogen Does
- Automated Google Business Profile post generation and scheduling
- AI-powered review reply automation
- Magic QR for feedback and review collection
- Local search ranking tracking
- Multi-location Google Business Profile management

## Who It's For
Small and multi-location local businesses including gyms, salons, clinics, restaurants, bakeries, and service businesses looking to automate their Google Business Profile and improve local search visibility.

## Partnership Programs (three programs, India-wide)
- Program page: https://www.vizogen.in/partner
- Apply / track status: https://www.vizogen.in/partner-application
- Affiliate Partner: 20% recurring commission on every referral, minimum payout Rs.999, no joining fee.
- Prime Plus Partner: up to 30% recurring commission across all revenue streams, agency co-branding, dedicated Partner Growth Manager, city exclusivity, inbound client leads forwarded by Vizogen.
- White-Labelled Partner: resell Vizogen on your own domain, logo and pricing; you set client pricing and collect payments; Vizogen handles hosting, engineering and API stability. Custom pricing by client volume.
- Who can apply: digital marketing freelancers, local SEO consultants, marketing agencies, IT resellers and business consultants working with local businesses.
- Coverage: all of India, including Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Jaipur, Lucknow and Kolkata.
- Process: apply online, receive a reference code instantly and by email, reviewed within 48 business hours, status trackable with code + email.
